name: File upload
description: A drop area for files, with each file checked for type and size and shown as a row with upload progress.

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted types: extensions such as ".gpx", MIME types such as "image/png", or "image/*". Other files get a failed row that says so.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Largest file in bytes. Larger files get a failed row.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow several files at once. When false, a new file replaces the list.

props.name: upload
props.type: (file: File, onProgress: (fraction: number) => void, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<void>
props.description: Sends one file and reports progress from 0 to 1. Reject to fail the row with your message; the signal aborts when the row is removed. When left out, progress is simulated.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with every row (name, size, status, progress, error, file) whenever the list changes.

props.name: defaultItems
props.description: Rows to start with, for files sent earlier.

props.name: hint
props.description: Replaces the muted line that lists accepted types and the size limit.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Turns off dropping and choosing, and dims the component.
